- **Guard:** no crossguard bar. Four small peel flaps split from the top of
  the grip, arch out a little, and hang down around the hand like a cup
  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  is brass (the skin).

  guard, curling in across their width to hug it. They are kept to about 10 cm
  across so the weapon can be sheathed and worn. The outer face of each is
  chrome (the inside of the peeled-back peel) and the face toward the hand
  is brass (the skin).

  is brass (the skin).

  is brass (the skin).

  is brass (the skin).
